##### Project general facts

Azha Millennium Residences by Azha Properties is a contemporary residential tower that expresses elegance and movement through clean vertical lines, sculpted contours and flowing, wave-like balconies. The tower rises above a basement, a ground floor and a four-level podium to thirty residential floors and a roof, blending hospitality-inspired design with residential comfort. The collection offers studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, with select homes enjoying expansive terraces and private decks and limited premium residences on the upper floors.

A hotel-inspired array of amenities enriches daily life. Residents enjoy a panoramic rooftop pool and lounge, a health club with a sauna and changing rooms, indoor and outdoor gyms and a jogging track. A cinema, entertainment rooms, indoor and outdoor children's play areas, barbecue areas, a cafe lounge and landscaped gardens with seating add variety, complemented by concierge, housekeeping, valet parking, in-residence dining, round-the-clock security and smart home systems.

Interiors are designed around refined aesthetics and immersive comfort, blending contemporary materials, soft textures, curated lighting and elegant details. Lobbies showcase marble finishes and artistic compositions, while apartments feature modern kitchens, spa-inspired bathrooms and fluid layouts with floor-to-ceiling openings. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Triangle is a green, family-friendly community known for its landscaped parks, walking paths and a balanced mix of villas, townhouses and apartment buildings. Al Khail Avenue, neighbourhood cafes, supermarkets, schools and clinics cover daily needs close to home, while the calm, low-density streets offer a relaxed setting at the centre of residential Dubai.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Al Khail Road and Sheikh Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city. Circle Mall and Dubai Hills Mall are a short drive away, Mall of the Emirates, Burj Al Arab and Dubai Marina are close by, and Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Jumeirah Village Triangle is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular family-oriented addresses in Dubai. Hospitality-inspired towers with extensive services are in demand among professionals and investors seeking premium rentals. A central position between the coastal districts and the inland business hubs underpins steady demand, attractive yields and long-term value for owners.
